diplomacy.name: /diplomacy [country_name]
diplomacy.desc: Show diplomacy info for countries. If `country_name` is provided, shows details for that country; otherwise shows a paginated list of countries with diplomacy records (3 per page). Government-only fields (diplomacy list) are shown when you have the government role.

update_diplomacy.name: /update_diplomacy country_name [status] [diplomacy] [description]
update_diplomacy.desc: Government-only. Update an existing diplomacy record: set `status`, append a `diplomacy` entry, or update `description`. New diplomacy entries are automatically dated. Status must be one of the predefined options and autocomplete is available.

add_diplomacy.name: /add_diplomacy country_name [status] [description]
add_diplomacy.desc: Government-only. Create a new diplomacy record for a country. If a record already exists, use `/update_diplomacy`.

remove_diplomacy.name: /remove_diplomacy country_name position
remove_diplomacy.desc: Government-only. Remove the diplomacy list entry at the provided 1-based `position`.

delete_diplomacy.name: /delete_diplomacy country_name
delete_diplomacy.desc: Government-only. Delete the diplomacy record for the specified country.

nap.name: /nap add country_a country_b | /nap remove country_a country_b | /nap list
nap.desc: Government-only. Manage the internal NAP list used by the hourly battle monitor. Country fields support autocomplete from the current WarEra country list.

priority.name: /priority list | /priority refresh | /priority add link description | /priority set entry_number description | /priority move entry_number_a entry_number_b | /priority remove entry_number
priority.desc: Manage battle order priorities from the battle order monitor cache. `list` shows active priorities with descriptions; government-only actions can refresh Romania order checks, add an active battle manually, set order descriptions, swap priorities, or remove a priority so it is not auto-added again unless manually added.

fightstatus.name: /fightstatus [military_unit]
fightstatus.desc: Fetch fight status for fighters. Without `military_unit`, operates on members with the configured 'fight' role; with `military_unit` fetches members of that unit. Results are paginated (10 per page) and include buff/debuff status, health/hunger, level, and online state. Filters for Buffed/Neutral/Debuffed available.

country_strays.name: /country_strays
country_strays.desc: List players whose in-game citizenship is not in the configured allowed countries. Results are paginated.

discorless.name: /discorless
discorless.desc: List Romania citizens from WarEra who are not present in Discord with the Citizen or Newbie role. Results are matched against server display names and paginated.

inactive_players.name: /inactive_players
inactive_players.desc: List players who have been inactive for more than 3 days. Results are paginated.

mu_stray.name: /mu_stray
mu_stray.desc: List MU strays categorised as Wrong MU, No MU, or Inactive Strays. Filter buttons on the result view switch between categories.

subscriptions.name: /subscribe contracts | /unsubscribe contracts
subscriptions.desc: Get pinged in your military unit's contracts thread or channel when it wins a mercenary contract. Your Discord account must be linked to your WarEra player, and you must be in one of this server's military units. The unit is not stored: you are pinged for the contracts of whichever unit you are in when one is won, so changing unit needs no new subscription. You are not pinged while you are on an economy build or have no skill points, or cannot fight (health under 10 and no hunger left, or in debuff). Leaving the server removes your subscription. Replies are only visible to you.

subscriptions_loot.name: /subscribe loot | /unsubscribe loot
subscriptions_loot.desc: Get a DM in the last ~10 minutes of each round of a battle you hit, with the round's and the battle's loot pools as `/loot_targets` shows them: your rank, damage and item, what the next rank and a better rarity need, and who below could take your rarity. It also estimates the damage your current gear, battle bonus, health and hunger can still deal, and the best item that damage reaches. Only battles where you hold an item or could reach one are sent. You get nothing while you are on an economy build or have no skill points, or cannot fight (health under 10 and no hunger left, or in debuff). Your Discord account must be linked to your WarEra player, and you must accept DMs from this server's members. Leaving the server removes your subscription. Replies are only visible to you.

pills.name: /pills military_unit
pills.desc: Pill status of a configured military unit (autocomplete): who is pilled, grouped by the hour they pilled, who is in debuff, grouped by the hour it ends (both with time left), and fighters not pilled. Hours are shown in the configured timezone.

fight_wealth.name: /fight_wealth military_unit
fight_wealth.desc: Fight wealth of every member of a configured military unit (autocomplete): money, items, equipment and weapons, companies excluded. Members are ranked richest first and grouped by tier: GOLD ≥15K, SILVER 10K–15K, BRONZE 5K–10K, IRON <5K. The daily report to MU leaders shows the tier counts and the richest names of each tier.

mu_order_alignment.name: /mu_order_alignment military_unit
mu_order_alignment.desc: Check whether the active battle orders of a configured military unit (autocomplete) follow Romania's country orders. Lists MU orders on the opposite side, MU orders on battles Romania did not order, Romania orders the MU has not copied, aligned orders and tournament orders, with each order's priority level and the battle's place in `/priority list`. The reply is posted in the channel; nobody is pinged.

mu_positions.name: /mu_positions military_unit [battle]
mu_positions.desc: Where the members of a configured military unit (autocomplete) stand. Without `battle`: members grouped by current region, the active battles that can be fought from each region, and how many members are in position for each battle the MU or Romania ordered. With `battle` (autocomplete, MU and Romania orders first, or a battle link): who is in position for the side the MU ordered (else Romania's side), who stands where only the other side can be hit, and everyone else sorted by distance with the trip cost in stamina and oil (10 stamina per region, 2 oil per region stamina does not cover) and 🏠 when the free trip home gets them there. The reply is posted in the channel; nobody is pinged.

mu_readiness.name: /mu_readiness military_unit
mu_readiness.desc: Commander checklist for a configured military unit (autocomplete): headquarters status, whether MU orders follow Romania's, fighters in position for each MU order, the latest won contract on an active battle, pills, health and hunger, MU help (and buffed fighters who can still ask), gear without a weapon or at or below 20% durability, the MU tournament while one is open (registration, rarity cap) and leaders online in the last 24h. ⚠️ counts only objective problems. Oil and paper stock and contract progress are not visible to the bot. The reply is posted in the channel; nobody is pinged.

loot_targets.name: /loot_targets battle [military_unit]
loot_targets.desc: Live preview of a battle's loot pools (autocomplete, or a link): the current round's pool and the whole battle's pool, shown together because a player competes for both at once. Pool items go by rank in the combined damage ranking of both sides, the most valuable to rank 1. For every member of the configured military units (or of `military_unit`) who hit the battle, in each pool: rank, damage and the item they would get now, the damage to pass the next rank, and the damage to reach the closest rank holding a better rarity (🤝 when a teammate holds it). It also shows how many players below would have to pass them before they drop to a lower rarity, with the damage each one needs, and the damage needed for each rarity. A snapshot: the pool grows and ranks move. The reply is posted in the channel; nobody is pinged.

promotions.name: /promotions
promotions.desc: Check newbie members for promotion eligibility. Shows Promotion Candidates, Fight Issues, Inactive, and Data Issues — filter buttons on the result view switch between categories.

top_user_weekly_damages.name: /top_user_weekly_damages country
top_user_weekly_damages.desc: Show the top 10 weekly damage dealers from one or more selected countries. Separate multiple countries with commas; results are grouped by player level bracket and include each player's country.

top_user_weekly_donations.name: /top_user_weekly_donations country
top_user_weekly_donations.desc: Show the top 10 citizens by money donated since Monday at 00:00 UTC. The required country field supports autocomplete using the current country list from WarEra.

get_region_upgrade_cost.name: /get_region_upgrade_cost country
get_region_upgrade_cost.desc: Calculate daily oil upkeep and market cost for active bunkers, military bases, and pacification centers in regions held by the selected country. The required country field supports autocomplete.

run_job.name: /run_job job_name
run_job.desc: Developers only; commanders can run only skill_roles and military_unit_roles. Force a background job to run once now, without waiting for or changing its loop timer. Refused while the job is already running; a scheduled run due during a forced run is skipped. The job field supports autocomplete.

setlang.name: /setlang language
setlang.desc: Developer-only. Set the language the bot uses in this server (English or Romanian): command responses, buttons, reports, alerts and the DMs this server triggers. The language field supports autocomplete.

skill_roles.name: skill_roles — every 1 hour
skill_roles.desc: Scans server members with the Citizen role and assigns/removes Economy or Fighter roles based on their in-game skill distribution. Sends a summary to the reports channel when changes occur.

military_unit_roles.name: military_unit_roles — every 3 hours
military_unit_roles.desc: Assigns Military Unit roles to members based on their in-game MU membership and removes conflicting MU roles. Members linked to a player whose server nickname doesn't match that player's in-game username lose all MU roles. Sends a summary to the reports channel when changes occur.

commander_roles.name: commander_roles — every 3 hours
commander_roles.desc: Syncs the Discord commander role with the commanders configured across all military units.

unidentified_members.name: unidentified_members — every 6 hours
unidentified_members.desc: Checks Citizen/Newbie members to see if their nickname maps to a known game user. Records mappings when found and reports unidentified players to the reports channel.

takeover_countries.name: takeover_countries — every 5 minutes
takeover_countries.desc: Scans countries and reports those that appear empty (no government/congress members), posting takeover opportunities to the public channel.

buff_monitor.name: buff_monitor — every 10 minutes
buff_monitor.desc: Monitors fighter buffs and notifies users when their active pill buff is nearing expiration (uses an internal cache to avoid repeated notifications).

bounty_monitor.name: bounty_monitor — configurable interval
bounty_monitor.desc: Checks active battles for money pools/bounties and posts a summary to the public channel when relevant (interval set by `BOUNTY_MONITOR_INTERVAL_MINUTES` in config).

mercenary_contracts.name: mercenary_contracts — every 1 minute
mercenary_contracts.desc: Checks active mercenary contract auctions and posts new or updated contracts to the public channel.

mu_contract_monitor.name: mu_contract_monitor — every 5 minutes
mu_contract_monitor.desc: Posts an embed in a military unit's contracts thread (threadIds.contractsId) or channel when that MU wins a mercenary contract: battle, minimum damage, pay per 1k damage, total payout, estimated time left and score. Pings the members subscribed with /subscribe contracts who are in that MU at that moment, are on a fight build, have health 10+ or hunger left and are not in debuff. Subscribers who left the server are unsubscribed.

loot_alerts.name: loot_alerts — every 2 minutes
loot_alerts.desc: Runs only while someone is subscribed with /subscribe loot. When an active battle's round can end within 10 minutes (if the leading side wins every tick), DMs each subscriber who hit that battle its round and battle loot pools and the damage they can still deal, when they hold a pool item or could reach one. Subscribers on an economy build, with health under 10 and no hunger left, or in debuff get nothing. Each subscriber is checked once per round; rounds already ending when the bot starts are skipped. Subscribers who left the server are unsubscribed.

monitor_nap.name: monitor_nap - every 1 hour
monitor_nap.desc: Checks active battle country orders and MU-order nationalities against configured NAPs, then reports new violations to the reports channel.

battle_order_monitor.name: battle-order_monitor - every 5 minutes
battle_order_monitor.desc: Checks active battles for Romania country orders, adds new matches to the battle order priority cache, posts alerts in the battle-orders channel, and removes priorities for battles that ended.

reddit_monitor.name: reddit_monitor - every 5 minutes
reddit_monitor.desc: Checks r/RomaniaWarEra for posts from the last 24 hours and reports newly seen posts to the reports channel.

newbie_welcome.name: newbie_welcome - when the Newbie role is given
newbie_welcome.desc: When a member receives the Newbie role, mentions them in the newbie chat (chats.ro_newbie) with a welcome message: their server nickname, first steps, up to 5 configured military units with free spots (read live) and promotion to Citizen. Posts nothing on a restart or for members who already had the role.

damage.model_text:
• One Pill a day: you fight only during the 8 h buff, starting with full bars, so you use 1.8 Health bars and 1.8 Hunger bars of food.
• Gear: average rolls at average market prices, 100 durability, 1 lost per hit (the weapon on every hit, other gear only on hits that are not dodged). Every weapon except the Knife uses 1 ammo per hit.
• Returns: cases at market price (Loot Chance per hit that is not a miss, elite = 1/100 of that), broken gear gives 1/3 of its scrap, round/battle pool items (1 per 200k + 1 per 500k damage), company engine output.
• Damage is an estimate (miss = ½ Attack, crit = Attack × (1 + Crit Damage)). Respec, travel and bounties are not included.
